units.source_text: 女人没有改变姿势，只是稍稍错开了原来的位置。

en.t: The woman did not change her posture; she had only shifted slightly from where she had been.

units.source_text: 她的脸冲着门口，大概想听听外面的动静吧。

en.t: Her face was turned toward the doorway, probably so she could listen for what was happening outside.

units.source_text: 遇到光，她眼睛眨了一下，立刻又紧紧地闭了起来。

en.t: When the light hit her, her eyes blinked once, then immediately shut tight again.

units.source_text: 他所受到的残酷对待，那女人究竟会怎样看待呢？

en.t: How, after all, would that woman regard the cruel treatment he had suffered?
... If she wanted to cry, let her cry; if she wanted to laugh, let her laugh ...
He still could not count it as a defeat.

units.source_text: 反正捏着定时炸弹钥匙的还是我自己呀。

en.t: After all, I am still the one holding the key to the time bomb.
